details:
"Opportunity - The Valiant Steel Heart" is an immersive storytelling and educational project developed on Canva that bridges historical space data with a futuristic survival narrative. The presentation maps out the legendary 15-year Martian journey of NASA's Opportunity rover, highlighting its breakthrough discoveries of ancient water through microscopic images of hematite "blueberries" and satellite traverse maps.

The narrative then takes a creative leap to the year 2035, where a stranded crew of six young engineers from Team A10 discovers the abandoned rover on Mars. Facing a communication blackout, the team resurrects Oppy's highly durable chassis, transforming a historical artifact into an active emergency rescue communication hub to reconnect with Earth.

By utilizing NASA open data (NASA Open Data/JPL-Caltech), this project simplifies complex planetary science into an engaging, emotionally resonant narrative for students and the general public. Our creativity lies in redefining documented mechanical constraints—such as dust build-up and flash memory failure—into dramatic plot devices that emphasize engineering adaptability. Team A10 carefully optimized the presentation for a close-up roundtable laptop display, using high-contrast layouts, clean typography, and interactive physical cues to inspire STEM curiosity and highlight resource optimization under extreme conditions
